name: fe-fe3-rotate-scale-gizmos
title: Electron UI FE3: rotate and scale gizmos (maths, drawing, hit-testing, drags as one undo step), plus the two F2 lows
issue: Roadmap C:/Method Notes Obsidian/orchestrator/proposals/electron-ui-roadmap.md section 4 (Candidate 1: rotate and scale gizmos, snapping, local/world, shortcuts; PR FE3 = the rotate/scale maths and drags; FE4 (toolbar, snapping settings, shortcuts) is the NEXT item: do not build the toolbar or snapping UI), decisions U3 (W/E/R shortcuts: you may register the actions gizmo.translate/rotate/scale in the keymap with default chords W/E/R and Q for select-only ONLY if the existing translate gizmo has a mode concept; otherwise expose a mode on the viewport controller and register the actions: verify against the code), U4 (snap defaults are FE4's), U5 (inspector local transform is FE5). Read the existing translate gizmo and its pure maths first: src/renderer/viewport-gizmo.ts, viewport-controller.ts, viewport-math.ts, viewport-input.ts, viewport-selection.ts, edit-controller.ts and edit groups, README viewport section. SCOPE: (1) rotate gizmo: three axis rings (world axes by default; local axes only if the roadmap says FE3 includes the space toggle: check) drawn on the overlay canvas at constant screen size with front/back fading, hit-testing by ring distance with a pick tolerance, dragging computes an angle delta around the axis from the pointer motion in the plane (stable at grazing angles: fall back to the screen-space tangent when the ring plane is edge-on), applies to the selected objects (the gizmo moves the whole selection as one undo step today for translate: do the same, rotating about the shared pivot per the roadmap or each object about its own pivot as the roadmap specifies), sends through the same SetLocalTransform/edit-group path as translate (ONE undo step per drag, cancel on Escape restores), (2) scale gizmo: three axis handles with end cubes plus a uniform-scale centre handle, drag math as a ratio from the pointer projection onto the axis (clamped away from zero and negative flips per the roadmap), applied as local scale with the same undo/cancel behaviour, (3) a mode on the controller (translate|rotate|scale), keyboard actions through the keymap, the current mode shown in the viewport (small text label until FE4's toolbar), (4) all maths in framework-free unit-tested files (ring hit/drag angle, scale ratio, constant-size, plane fallbacks, quaternion composition and Euler display consistency), DOM tests for mode switching, drag lifecycle (down/move/up/cancel) with a fake edit backend asserting exactly one edit group and the right transform commands, multi-selection, locked/read-only hosts (no drags when canWrite is false), (5) the TWO F2 LOWS: viewport.frame is a code chord (KeyF) but also matches any key whose e.key is 'f' (the old code was physical-key only and the README says so): make the matching physical-key only for code chords, test with a non-Latin layout simulation; bind() accepts chord lists that the KeymapOverridesPref validator rejects (more than 8 chords) and silently drops them: make bind() enforce the same limit and report the error, test, (6) README viewport section updated and verified. Frontend rules: requiresDocs false (README only); run npm run typecheck and npm test locally before every push; no token in logs/storage; keep changes inside the files your lane owns (other frontend lanes are in flight at the same time: keymap action registrations and README additions will conflict mechanically, keep them as small separate hunks); no engine/protocol change unless this item says so. Read the roadmap section named in this item, decisions U1-U21 (all ACCEPTED by the user on 2026-10-20), the frontend README and the code you touch FIRST; F1 (panel registry/layout) and F2 (prefs store and keymap) are merged: use them (register panels through the registry, shortcuts through the keymap, preferences through the prefs store).
acceptance: Rotate and scale gizmos with correct maths, constant screen size, edge-on fallbacks, one undo step per drag, Escape cancels, read-only respected
Mode switch via keymap actions and a viewport label; no toolbar/snapping yet
The two F2 lows fixed with tests
Unit + DOM tests; typecheck, build, tests and frontend CI green; README updated
notes: Reviewer: gizmo maths correct (angle wrap, grazing planes, pivot semantics, degenerate scale), exactly one edit group per drag, cancel restores exactly, no frame request leaks, keymap integration (scopes, text entry), read-only/viewer, F2 lows really fixed, tests meaningful, README true, mediums count. Unverified: feel in a real viewport.
